description: This file defines the 'Coupon' controller class for the OpenCart admin extension, managing the coupon total configuration page including display and save functionality.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class handling coupon total settings in the OpenCart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, loads templates for header, footer, and left column, and outputs the coupon configuration page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the coupon total configuration, including permission checks and returning success/error message in JSON format.
